extracted.intended_audience: fiction authors (indie and traditionally published) seeking a sample line/copyedit
extracted.subtask_description: A 1,000-word, line-by-line sample edit demonstrating sentence-level corrections and an assessment of narrative, dialogue, pacing, representation, formatting and mechanics to show fit before commissioning a full edit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative and dialogue drive novel forward and flow well
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring your narrative and dialogue drive your novel forward and flow well on the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The sample edit will show how the editor works by correcting and smoothing prose to ensure narrative momentum and readable flow; comments may be added in the Word file to explain decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter sequencing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checking order and structural progression of chapters to ensure story logic and momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cliché and awkward metaphor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify overused phrases, tired imagery and metaphors that jar or weaken prose; suggest fresher alternatives or tightening.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dialogue expression (authenticity of phrasing and word choice)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dialogue expression: particularly authenticity of phrasing and word choice in relation to character voice, mood and intention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether dialogue matches character voice and conveys the intended mood and intention; flag unnatural phrasing or voice inconsistencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness of sentence-level narration
rubrics_metrics.description: Effectiveness of sentence-level narration, including an assessment of word choice, repetition and overwriting, especially in action and suspense scenes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess word choice, repetitiveness and overwriting at the sentence level; pay special attention to clarity and tightness in action and suspense to maintain pace and tension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness of suspense and thrill points
rubrics_metrics.description: Effectiveness of suspense and thrill points
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether suspense beats and thriller moments land effectively; suggest adjustments to structure, wording, or pacing to heighten tension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Layout guidance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide advice on visual presentation and document layout that affects readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letter, word, line and paragraph spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Letter, word, line and paragraph spacing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check micro-typographic and spacing issues that impact readability and professional presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Problematic representation, stereotyping and othering
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify representations that may be harmful or stereotypical and flag potential issues; the service includes resources to help writers consider whether wording causes unintended harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentence pace, rhythm and flow (match to setting and mood)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sentence pace, rhythm and flow, and whether it reflects the setting and mood of a scene
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether sentence length, rhythm and cadence support the scene's setting and mood; recommend edits to align prose rhythm with atmosphere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speech tagging and punctuation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check and correct dialogue attribution and punctuation for clarity and conventional correctness; ensure tags do not undermine voice or pacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling, grammar, syntax, punctuation, hyphenation and capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Spelling, grammar, syntax, punctuation, hyphenation and capitalization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Line-level correction of mechanical issues to ensure accuracy and readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard document formatting using Word’s styles palette
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard document formatting using Word’s styles palette: indentation, paragraph style, section breaks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure document is formatted professionally using Word styles for consistent indentation, paragraph styling and section breaks; practical formatting fixes are part of the sample.

rubrics_metrics.name: Told versus shown prose
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag instances of telling rather than showing and suggest strategies to show rather than tell where appropriate to increase immediacy and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of tenses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for tense consistency and appropriate tense choices for scenes and narrative voice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verb use to create tension and suspense
rubrics_metrics.description: Verb use, especially to create tension and suspense
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess verb selection and placement as tools to heighten action and suspense; recommend stronger, more precise verbs or shifts in aspect/voice to increase tension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory comments and editorial transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Where appropriate, I'll write comments in your Word file to explain my decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide rationale for edits via comments so the author understands why changes were made and can apply learning to the larger manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive and respectful writing resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on inclusive and respectful writing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service includes a free booklet with resources and tools to help writers consider whether wording enriches readers or causes unintended harm, supporting conscious language judgement.
